protocol.hypothesis: Automation may reduce source-reading and manual coordination backlog and hence physical service time; strong automated conventional references may tie or win.
protocol.scope: Separate internal scenario family with explicit hypothetical human-capacity parameters. It does not replace prior B5/B8 comparisons or claim empirically calibrated human productivity/errors.

arms.C_manual: Distributed finite human source reading, integration and real relay; finite received-need decisions and partner handoff; competent common allocator afterward.
arms.C_decentralized: Independent manual teams with native read/decide and factual need/intent/status relays; each drafts only its own capacity. Real stale communication may or may not cause duplicate physical supply.
arms.B5: Strong shared conventional planner: free exact parsing, native finite manual reading of other public sources, automated inquiries and common allocation.
arms.B8: Strong free broad keyword/public-location discovery with automated inquiries and the common allocator. No artificial reading/decision/relay penalty.
arms.B6: Bounded real-model public-source perception, automated received-data inquiries under the same approved policy and the common allocator. No extra human query gate.

protocol.fairness: Identical seed, public input bytes, formal report delay, resource/fleet/field capacities, physical rules, consent and owner reviews in every arm. Human reviews share the native decision pool in ALL arms. No human task creates truth, certifies safety or authorizes aid.
protocol.manualRouting: Public source ID hash assigns each manual reader to one of four owners. After a completed read, competent common interpretation triages nonactionable material without extra decision/relay work; actionable local decisions stay local, other owners relay actual completed snapshots to owner0. Integrated operational needs are handed only to foreign owners selected by the common received-data allocation preview; owned capacity requires no partner relay. These are declared workflow assumptions, not measured universal practice.

profiles.zero: No source-reading/integration/relay duration, background load or human task error; native owner review remains finite.
profiles.moderate: Source defaults: 2 readers/2 deciders/1 relayer per owner, 30s/60s/90s work, no background work or errors.
profiles.burst: Same finite pools/work; source-generated exogenous background read360/decision120/relay60 tasks per owner/hour. Hypothetical sensitivity, not disaster calibration.

protocol.failurePolicy: At most two attempts per inconclusive manual stage, with all receipts and errors retained. Missing relay, rejected work, unserved demand, unknown fees and provider failures are never counted as completed service.
protocol.clocks: Publication, HTTP receipt, native human work, model availability, inquiry and physical receipt are separate source clocks. Provider measured wall time is charged at max(native model latency, measured provider duration). Host SQL/UI wall time is separately reported.
protocol.coalescing: All arms recompile only after the received response material signature or eligible integrated need IDs change. Receipt ingestion, owner review, physical execution and unknown human/inquiry queues continue at each common60s pump or earlier received native readyAt; no private completion or skipped horizon. Public feed downloads occur only in the coordinator store actually consumed by this controller; distributed reading still obtains its own native authenticated source snapshot.
protocol.controls: Keep zero profile, moderate, burst, B5/B8 upper bounds, failed and censored worlds. Human errors are source-seeded and apply to the same owner review mechanism for NEXO; no arm-specific random error or forced duplicate score.
protocol.endpoint: First useful and sufficient physical service RMST at the fixed horizon, by native demand and resource units; background task completion or proposal approval is not aid.

manifest.reportingPolicy: Physical need at time zero; public source followed by the same delayed formal report for every arm. Source interpretation alone does not authorize a dispatch.
manifest.limitation: Internally authored synthetic cohort. Formal delay and human throughput require sensitivity tests; they are not field measurements.

utilization.definition: Piecewise source-clock integrals. Vehicle commitment includes preparation, handling, queue, blockage, cargo and actual return; idle/empty arrived capacity and background traffic are excluded. Staff commitment counts reserved people plus physical staff cargo once. Field work counts only assigned inspections/repairs in working phase. These are separate scopes, not sums of independent productive labor, wages or all responder work.

humanCapacity.note: Declared experimental staffing and work durations, not empirical human performance. Person-ms counts attention work or waiting, not wages or productivity. Percentiles exclude pending work; pending counts and cutoff are reported separately. Work receipt/relay/owner approval never counts as physical aid. Attention lapses are explicit inconclusive outcomes, not invented false facts.

collective.note: Operating hours alone are not useful service. Occupied shelter place-hours and finite water production are measured separately.

platformTransport.note: Actual platform peer HTTP is charged by the laboratory transport adapter; this is distinct from source-system messages.

information.note: These counts cover source-world claims only, not claims in an external platform database. Workflow acknowledgments are not semantic accuracy. Platform precision/recall requires matched external claims and independent task annotations.

firstUsefulServiceMs.note: First physical positive contribution to outstanding demand; partial service counts here, but not as sufficient service. Report firstUsefulRightCensored separately.

sufficientServiceMs.note: Sufficient physical service, completed positive-demand cases only; report right-censored cases alongside these percentiles.

needToServiceMs.note: Sufficient physical service, completed positive-demand cases only; report right-censored cases alongside these percentiles.

episodes.note: A new outstanding shortfall after coverage or retirement starts a new episode. Earlier aid is retained in history, never credited as response to a new episode. Withdrawn episodes are censored at withdrawal and must be reported separately; native resource quantities and integrals are not summed across types.

activities.note: Controller availability uses max(native latency, measured provider duration) from original requestedAt; native receipt timestamp remains unchanged and is not presented as exact HTTP availability.

definitions.time: Local review/audit wall-clock timestamps and source physical clocks are separate; never subtract or sum them.
definitions.denominator: All stored owner-scoped proposals and exact historical local review decisions; not only successful/completed plans. Delegated copies remain identified separately.
definitions.service: Positive independently recorded physical receipt of the exact issued delivery/evacuation. Receipt positivity is not marginal deficit reduction: redundant delivered supply can satisfy this contract. Payment, provision, assessment and activation alone get no positive-receipt credit.
definitions.legacyAliases: Deprecated usefulPhysicalService, usefulServiceProposals, partialUsefulServiceProposals, uniqueUsefulSourceOperations, completedWithoutDirectUsefulService and usefulPerReviewedProposal mean positive linked receipt presence/quantity, not aid benefit or deficit reduction. Use positivePhysicalService / uniquePositivePhysicalSourceOperations for receipt counts and native deficit/outcome metrics for benefit; no quantity is silently clamped here.
definitions.duplicates: A source operation may support coordinator and delegated review scopes. Unique owner+sourceID physical receipts are reported separately and never summed twice.
definitions.limits: Internal scripted review and post-execution attribution are mechanisms; these ratios do not measure human comprehension, correctness of unseen semantic claims or field effectiveness.

profiler.note: Host instrumentation only; no measured SQL/HTTP duration is used to advance physical time. Store-query counts exclude internal transaction-client calls. All owners use the same instrumentation.
